tools.title: Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive)
tools.summary: Email, calendar, files and office documents.

servers.name: Gmail MCP server
servers.capabilities: Read and act on Gmail messages.
servers.access: Gmail messages, read and write (drafts, labels).
servers.scopes: OAuth scopes under https://www.googleapis.com/auth/: gmail.readonly, gmail.compose, gmail.modify. Requires the Workspace Developer Preview Program and an OAuth client marked for an AI-powered agent.

servers.name: Google Calendar MCP server
servers.capabilities: Read and manage Google Calendar events.
servers.access: Calendars and events, read and write.
servers.scopes: OAuth scopes under https://www.googleapis.com/auth/: calendar.calendarlist.readonly, calendar.events.freebusy, calendar.events.readonly, calendar.events. Requires the Workspace Developer Preview Program and an OAuth client marked for an AI-powered agent.

servers.name: Google Drive MCP server
servers.capabilities: Search and read Drive files; the drive.file scope can grant write access to specific files.
servers.access: Drive files: read all the user can see, write the files the app opened or created.
servers.scopes: OAuth scopes under https://www.googleapis.com/auth/: drive.readonly, drive.file. Requires the Workspace Developer Preview Program and an OAuth client marked for an AI-powered agent.

servers.name: Universal Search MCP server for Workspace
servers.capabilities: One search_corpus tool searching across Drive, Gmail, Calendar and Chat.
servers.access: Search across Drive, Gmail, Calendar and Chat; every scope it asks is read-only.
servers.scopes: OAuth scopes under https://www.googleapis.com/auth/: gmail.readonly, drive.readonly, calendar.readonly, chat.messages.readonly, chat.spaces.readonly, chat.memberships.readonly. Requires the Workspace Developer Preview Program and an OAuth client marked for an AI-powered agent.

read_only.how: Every tool reads: the server asks only read-only scopes.

tools.notes: Developer Preview: requires membership in the Google Workspace Developer Preview Program, a Google Cloud project with the product API and its MCP service enabled, and an OAuth client. Docs, Sheets, Slides, Chat, People and Classroom have their own endpoints on the same page.

tools.title: Microsoft 365 (Outlook, SharePoint)
tools.summary: Email, calendar, files and intranet sites in Microsoft 365.

servers.name: Work IQ MCP
servers.capabilities: Single endpoint with generic tools to read, create, update and delete Microsoft 365 entities (mail, meetings, files, Teams chats, people); the retrieve tool is still in preview.
servers.scopes: api://workiq.svc.cloud.microsoft/WorkIQAgent.Ask. Consent: Tenant-wide Entra administrator consent and delegated sign-in with the user's Microsoft 365 permissions.

servers.name: Work IQ CLI (MCP server mode)
servers.capabilities: Query emails, meetings, documents, Teams messages, people and business-app data from Microsoft 365 Copilot in natural language.
servers.access: Read operations described; no enforced read-only mode is recorded.

tools.notes: Work IQ needs delegated Microsoft Entra auth with tenant-wide admin consent and a Copilot Studio usage-based billing plan (Copilot Credits); app-only auth is not supported. Microsoft's older workload servers (Teams, Mail, Calendar, SharePoint, OneDrive, preview) are kept only for backward compatibility and must not be used for new projects.

tools.title: Microsoft Teams
tools.summary: Chat, meetings and channels in Microsoft 365.

servers.name: Work IQ MCP
servers.capabilities: Single endpoint with generic tools to read, create, update and delete Microsoft 365 entities (mail, meetings, files, Teams chats, people); the retrieve tool is still in preview.
servers.access: Microsoft 365 emails, meetings, files, chats and business-system data of the signed-in user, within that user's permissions; data may leave the Azure compliance boundary.
servers.scopes: Delegated Microsoft Entra auth only, scope api://workiq.svc.cloud.microsoft/WorkIQAgent.Ask; a Global Administrator provisions the Work IQ service principal and grants tenant-wide admin consent once; usage is billed in Copilot Credits.

servers.name: Work IQ CLI (MCP server mode)
servers.capabilities: Query emails, meetings, documents, Teams messages, people and business-app data from Microsoft 365 Copilot in natural language.
servers.access: Emails, meetings, documents, Teams messages, people and business-application data the signed-in user can already view; nothing is stored by Work IQ.
servers.scopes: Permissions that need administrative consent for the Work IQ application in the Microsoft Entra tenant, a Copilot Studio usage-based billing plan the user is assigned to, and acceptance of the EULA (workiq accept-eula).

tools.notes: Work IQ needs delegated Microsoft Entra auth with tenant-wide admin consent and a Copilot Studio usage-based billing plan (Copilot Credits); app-only auth is not supported. Microsoft's older workload servers (Teams, Mail, Calendar, SharePoint, OneDrive, preview) are kept only for backward compatibility and must not be used for new projects.

tools.title: Slack

servers.name: Slack MCP server
servers.capabilities: Search messages, files, users and channels; read channel history and threads; send, schedule and draft messages; create and update canvases and lists; upload files.
servers.access: Search and read messages, files, channels, threads and users; send, schedule and draft messages, create channels, add reactions, create and update canvases, upload files, update lists.
servers.scopes: User-token scopes per tool: search:read.* (search), chat:write (send), *:history (read channels and threads), canvases:read and canvases:write, files:write, lists:read and lists:write, reactions:read and reactions:write. Admins approve MCP client integrations; only Marketplace and internal apps can use MCP.

tools.notes: The client must be backed by a Slack app published in the Slack Marketplace or an internal app, and workspace admins approve MCP clients; no SSE and no dynamic client registration.
